clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, Lightning Glands are taken from stormhides roaming the plains. Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet needs them for trogg ale, a fiery brew Chen Stormstout taught him to make.

Stormhides roam the Barrens savannas among other predators touched by the elements. Their flesh holds lightning glands, organs charged with latent electricity. These glands are poor fare on their own, but brewers prize them for the sting they bring to a brew.

Brewmaster Drohn keeps Chen Stormstout’s brewing traditions alive in Ratchet. To make trogg ale, a potent brew, Drohn needs five lightning glands, a thunderhawk saliva gland, and a fresh kodo liver. The finished drink has a sharp kick that adventurers find invigorating and potent.
